# Radoslav Radev Recommends Warming Up by Increasing Body Temperature One Degree Before Calisthenics Training

Radoslav Radev recommends warming up by increasing the body temperature with one degree before calisthenics training, and that one degree is definitely enough. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:36]

## Details

- The warm-up is increasing the body temperature with one degree, and one degree increasing the body temperature is definitely enough. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:36]
- If you get a little bit sweat, that means it's really good and you're ready to start. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:58]
- Doing jumping jacks, back flips, running, or jump rope is much better than just rotating the lower back, elbows, and head. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:36]
- After the body temperature warm-up, you can do stretching, the shoulders for the planche, the biceps, rotate the wrists and elbows. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:08]
- The warm-up that increases your body temperature is the most important. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:14]

## Evidence

- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:36 (Radoslav Radev): "The warmup is increasing the body temperature with one degree so if you do jumping jacks or if you do back flips or running or jump rope is much better than just rotating the lower back elbows like this the head like this and that's not a warm-up"
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:58 (Radoslav Radev): "one degree increasing the body temperature is definitely enough if you get a little bit sweat that means it's really good and you're ready to start"
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:08 (Radoslav Radev): "And after that, yes, you can do your stretching, the shoulders for the planche, the biceps as well, to rotate the wrists, the elbows as well."
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:14 (Radoslav Radev): "But the warm-up that increasing your body temperature is the most important."

## Why This Matters

He says that many people get injured because the joints are cold, and rotating the lower back and elbows is not a warm-up. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:48]
